name: Erogaki! Shounen Danshou no 3-kakan Taiken Gakushuu ~Ichinichime~
original_name: エロガキッ!少年男娼の3日間体験学習～いちにちめ～
source:
Yusuke Shirai, a very ordinary office worker, goes to the "Boy Male Prostitute Club" every Friday after work.

While androgynous beautiful boys and boys from other boys' homes are popular, this club decides to help train Genki Yamashita, an unpopular new male prostitute!

Through a three-day "experiential learning" program, you can have some intense physical contact, deepen your friendship, and turn Genki into a fine male prostitute (erotic kid)!

Maybe boyish boys are okay too...?
